product.name: Letterline
product.tagline: Purpose-bound audiences, consent evidence, reviewed campaigns, and provider-neutral dispatch plans.

module.description: Purpose-bound audiences, immutable consent and suppression evidence, reviewed campaign versions, cited AI proposals, and provider-neutral dispatch plans.
module.scaleGuidance: Use Scale for large audiences, high provider-receipt volume, frequent campaigns, long retention, or large private exports.

backend.databaseBoundary: All shared database access and tenant isolation remain behind the managed-oss-cloud API.

cleanRoom.statement: Original clean-room implementation of the email marketing software category, designed and written independently.
cleanRoom.sourceBoundary: Public category behavior informed requirements; implementation and product identity are original.

actions.title: Create purpose-bound audience
actions.description: Create an audience with an explicit purpose and consent-policy boundary before collecting any address.

exampleInput.name: Product newsletter
exampleInput.purpose: Send a reviewed monthly product newsletter to people who opted in.

actions.cliExample: supersuite action email audience-create '{"name":"Product newsletter","purpose":"Send a reviewed monthly product newsletter to people who opted in.","consentPolicyVersion":"newsletter-consent-v1","idempotencyKey":"email.audience-create.sample-0001"}'
actions.productCliExample: letterline action audience-create '{"name":"Product newsletter","purpose":"Send a reviewed monthly product newsletter to people who opted in.","consentPolicyVersion":"newsletter-consent-v1","idempotencyKey":"email.audience-create.sample-0001"}'

actions.title: Record lawful subscriber opt-in
actions.description: Normalize and deduplicate one address while creating an immutable, purpose-specific consent receipt; purchased-list assumptions are rejected.

actions.title: Reconfirm suppressed subscriber
actions.description: Reactivate only a prior unsubscribe or manual suppression after a newer double opt-in; hard bounces, complaints, and legal blocks remain blocked.

actions.title: Suppress or unsubscribe immediately
actions.description: Apply an immutable unsubscribe, bounce, complaint, legal, or manual suppression before any future dispatch plan is created.

exampleInput.note: Recipient used the hosted unsubscribe control.

actions.cliExample: supersuite action email subscriber-suppress '{"subscriberId":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000102","reason":"unsubscribe","occurredAt":"2026-08-24T17:00:00.000Z","evidenceHash":"cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc","note":"Recipient used the hosted unsubscribe control.","idempotencyKey":"email.subscriber-suppress.sample-0001"}'
actions.productCliExample: letterline action subscriber-suppress '{"subscriberId":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000102","reason":"unsubscribe","occurredAt":"2026-08-24T17:00:00.000Z","evidenceHash":"cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc","note":"Recipient used the hosted unsubscribe control.","idempotencyKey":"email.subscriber-suppress.sample-0001"}'

actions.title: List audience subscribers
actions.description: List tenant-scoped subscriber records with an explicit choice about whether suppressed records are included.

actions.title: Create audience-bound campaign
actions.description: Create a campaign objective bound to one existing audience without drafting, scheduling, or sending content.

exampleInput.name: September product letter
exampleInput.objective: Explain reviewed product improvements to opted-in readers.

actions.cliExample: supersuite action email campaign-create '{"audienceId":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101","name":"September product letter","objective":"Explain reviewed product improvements to opted-in readers.","idempotencyKey":"email.campaign-create.sample-0001"}'
actions.productCliExample: letterline action campaign-create '{"audienceId":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101","name":"September product letter","objective":"Explain reviewed product improvements to opted-in readers.","idempotencyKey":"email.campaign-create.sample-0001"}'

actions.title: Create immutable campaign version
actions.description: Freeze an exact subject, sender identity, reply address, plain text, optional HTML, and required unsubscribe marker under an optimistic campaign version.

exampleInput.subject: September product notes
exampleInput.preheader: A concise review of this month's improvements.
exampleInput.footer: Example Product · Contact us at hello@example.com · {{unsubscribe_url}}

actions.cliExample:
supersuite action email campaign-version-draft '{"campaignId":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000103","expectedCampaignVersion":1,"subject":"September product notes","preheader":"A concise review of this month'''s improvements.","senderName":"Example Product","replyToEmail":"hello@example.com","bodyText":"Hello,

Here are the reviewed updates.

Unsubscribe: {{unsubscribe_url}}","footer":"Example Product · Contact us at hello@example.com · {{unsubscribe_url}}","idempotencyKey":"email.campaign-version-draft.sample-0001"}'
actions.productCliExample:
letterline action campaign-version-draft '{"campaignId":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000103","expectedCampaignVersion":1,"subject":"September product notes","preheader":"A concise review of this month's improvements.","senderName":"Example Product","replyToEmail":"hello@example.com","bodyText":"Hello,

actions.title: Propose cited subject lines
actions.description: Queue evidence-bound subject proposals that remain pending human review and cannot alter, approve, schedule, or send a campaign.

exampleInput.instruction: Propose concise subject lines supported by the selected evidence without urgency or unsupported claims.

actions.cliExample: supersuite action email subject-propose '{"campaignId":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000103","instruction":"Propose concise subject lines supported by the selected evidence without urgency or unsupported claims.","evidenceIds":["00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000106"],"idempotencyKey":"email.subject-propose.sample-0001"}'
actions.productCliExample: letterline action subject-propose '{"campaignId":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000103","instruction":"Propose concise subject lines supported by the selected evidence without urgency or unsupported claims.","evidenceIds":["00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000106"],"idempotencyKey":"email.subject-propose.sample-0001"}'

actions.title: Propose cited newsletter body
actions.description: Queue an evidence-bound plain-text body proposal with an unsubscribe marker; it remains unreviewed and cannot be dispatched.

exampleInput.instruction: Draft a factual newsletter body with citations and the required unsubscribe marker.

actions.cliExample: supersuite action email body-propose '{"campaignId":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000103","instruction":"Draft a factual newsletter body with citations and the required unsubscribe marker.","evidenceIds":["00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000106"],"idempotencyKey":"email.body-propose.sample-0001"}'
actions.productCliExample: letterline action body-propose '{"campaignId":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000103","instruction":"Draft a factual newsletter body with citations and the required unsubscribe marker.","evidenceIds":["00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000106"],"idempotencyKey":"email.body-propose.sample-0001"}'

actions.title: Record human content review
actions.description: Create an attributable review of the exact immutable campaign version and required consent, claims, unsubscribe, and sender-identity checks.

exampleInput.reason: The exact content and recipient purpose were reviewed.

actions.cliExample: supersuite action email campaign-review-record '{"campaignId":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000103","campaignVersionId":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000104","expectedCampaignVersion":2,"contentHash":"dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd","decision":"approved-for-approval","checklist":{"consentBoundaryReviewed":true,"claimsReviewed":true,"unsubscribeMechanismReviewed":true,"senderIdentityReviewed":true},"reason":"The exact content and recipient purpose were reviewed.","idempotencyKey":"email.campaign-review-record.sample-0001"}'
actions.productCliExample: letterline action campaign-review-record '{"campaignId":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000103","campaignVersionId":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000104","expectedCampaignVersion":2,"contentHash":"dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd","decision":"approved-for-approval","checklist":{"consentBoundaryReviewed":true,"claimsReviewed":true,"unsubscribeMechanismReviewed":true,"senderIdentityReviewed":true},"reason":"The exact content and recipient purpose were reviewed.","idempotencyKey":"email.campaign-review-record.sample-0001"}'

actions.title: Approve exact campaign version
actions.description: Bind attributable owner or administrator approval to one reviewed content hash; approval never sends or schedules the message.

actions.title: Schedule approved campaign
actions.description: Schedule the exact approved content and audience under a fresh human approval; no message or provider call is made.

actions.title: Create provider-neutral dispatch plan
actions.description: Freeze eligible recipient IDs and hashes after a fresh suppression check; the engine stores no credentials and makes no provider request.

actions.title: Ingest verified provider receipt
actions.description: Record a gateway-verified acceptance, delivery, bounce, complaint, or unsubscribe receipt idempotently; hard failures suppress before later plans.

actions.title: Aggregate verified delivery outcomes
actions.description: Return coarse counts from verified provider receipts only, with no fabricated opens, clicks, revenue, or attribution.

actions.title: Create private audience export
actions.description: Create a content-addressed private export manifest and return authorized rows once; provider credentials and suppression ambiguity are excluded.
